bifrost: No C-ABI Core Foundation layer. Foundation-level counterparts: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs, springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs, springboard/sdk/src/url.rs, springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs, springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs, springboard/sdk/src/log.rs, springboard/ui/src/format.rs, springboard/sdk/src/control.rs
summary: Core Foundation is the C ABI layer (CFTypeRef, opaque CF* types, CFAllocator, run loops, sockets, plug-ins) that Apple bridges to Foundation. BifrOSt is Rust and has no C ABI requirement, so the CF types themselves are n/a. The Foundation-level behaviour they back (preferences, notifications, main queue, URLs, locale, formatting, plists) has partial counterparts in the Foundation batches.

features.feature: Opaque CF types and CFAllocator (CFTypeRef, CFArray, CFDictionary, CFString, CFNumber, CFData)
features.apple: CFAllocator, CFArray, CFDictionary, CFString, CFNumber, CFData, CFBoolean, CFNull
features.bifrost: Rust std collections and types (no C ABI)
features.note: Ownership and bridging are Rust's job; no app-facing C ABI is needed

features.apple: Preferences Utilities, CFPreferences keys and domains
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs (UserDefaults, typed values, atomic per-app file); springboard/sdk/src/pref_domains.rs (PrefStore: CFPreferencesCopyAppValue/SetAppValue/AppSynchronize, any-application/user/host constants, NSGlobalDomain fallback, suite names, change notifications)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: Shared host domains work across simulated apps on the host store; not yet wired into UserDefaults or the shell, and not checked on Midget
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Observer add, post and remove exist; the object argument is a u64 handle, not an arbitrary object reference

features.feature: Run loop and timers (CFRunLoop, CFRunLoopTimer, CFRunLoopSource, CFRunLoopObserver)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs (DispatchQueue main, async_after, drain_main, wake fd)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. Main-queue dispatch and delayed work exist; no run-loop modes, observers or custom input sources

features.apple: CFURL, Core Foundation URL Access Utilities, CFURLEnumerator
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Network requests and cache exist; file URLs have a path value type (FileUrl: parse, component and extension edits, standardize); no bookmark data, URL-object resource-value caching or enumerator (file_manager.rs covers those)

features.feature: Locale and time zone (CFLocale, CFTimeZone, CFCalendar)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Locale identifier, separators, language, region_code, measurement_system, calendar_identifier); springboard/sdk/src/time_zone.rs (TZif reader, abbreviation, DST transitions, knownTimeZoneIdentifiers); springboard/sdk/src/calendar_system.rs (gregorian, buddhist, japanese, islamic-civil, hebrew, iso8601); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-24.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: Time zones from /usr/share/zoneinfo and calendars with dateComponents, date(byAdding:), range(of:in:for:) exist; Locale reports its region, measurement system and the calendar its language expects (parity_sdk-complete-24). Gap: time zone localized names ignore the locale; host tests only, not checked on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: Locale has calendar_identifier and measurement_system (springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs), so the calendar gap is closed; tests locale::tests.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (currency_symbol) and springboard/sdk/src/formatters/ (decimal, percent, currency, spellOut, ordinal; date patterns; DateComponentsFormatter; named relative days; iso8601); springboard/ui/src/format.rs (fixed shell helpers); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-24.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests (earlier part). Added later, host tests only: en, is and de separators; currency symbols cover USD, EUR, GBP, ISK, JPY, CAD, AUD, CNY, INR and KRW, and other codes are written as their code (parity_sdk-complete-24). Gap: spell-out is English only; host tests only, not checked on Midget

features.feature: Property lists and Codable-style encoding (CFPropertyList, CFXMLParser)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs (encode/decode, field, ISO 8601 format and parse)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Two encoders and a decoder exist; no XML property-list parser API for apps

The attributed container with range edits, runs, RTF and HTML and UTF-16 accessibility runs is tested headless in parity_sdk-tests-11.rs and attributed::tests. Gap: the CF statistical writing-direction call has no counterpart.

features.feature: Sockets, ports and streams (CFSocket, CFMachPort, CFMessagePort, CFStream)
features.note: Mach ports and CF streams are Apple-specific; the control socket covers app-to-shell RPC only

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Info dictionary from manifest.toml, resource lookup and an in-process plug-in factory registry; no dynamic loading of plug-in bundles. Host unit tests only, not yet checked on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/sdk/src/cf_bundle.rs (CfBundle, PlugInRegistry); tests cf_bundle::tests.

gaps: CFURL: FileUrl (springboard/sdk/src/file_url.rs) covers file paths only; no non-file schemes, bookmark data, resource-value caching on the URL object or enumerator; springboard/sdk/src/file_manager.rs covers resource values and directory enumeration.

UserDefaults::with_store (defaults.rs) reads through the app domain, added suites, the global domain and registered values (host tests only); the shell and apps still use the per-app file store via open, and the search list is not yet checked on Midget.
Calendar/TimeZone are not yet used by DateFormatter (it takes an explicit tz_offset).
